info.title: hypot Auth API
info.description: API-only centralized authentication for first-party apps. JSON in and out, no cookies, no redirects, no HTML. Business routes live under /api/v1; JWKS, / and /health are at the root. Prose contract: docs/api-contract.md.

get.description: Operational only. No CORS, no limits.
Pings the database. No CORS, no limits.
Public RSA keys that verify access tokens (RS256). During rotation current and previous keys are published. The URL is `${iss}/.well-known/jwks.json`. Consumed server to server: no CORS.

post.description:
Always answers the same 202 for a new and an existing address. A new account is unconfirmed and gets a confirmation email (24 h link); an existing address gets an "account exists" notice. No tokens are issued.

A request with an Origin header is allowed only when the origin is bound to the app the request identifies; the allow header is granted fail-closed. See docs/api-contract.md, section CORS.

202.description: Accepted. Fixed text, identical for a new and an existing address.

415.description: The Content-Type is not application/json, or is missing. No allow header, no limit counted.

429.description: An IP-keyed limit was hit. The decision never depends on account or token state.

503.description: The limiter store is down. The request was not processed.

post.description:
Takes the token from the `#token` fragment of the email link. The token identifies the app. There is no GET form: a link scanner cannot confirm an account.

get.description: A request with an Origin header is allowed only when the origin is bound to the app the request identifies; the allow header is granted fail-closed. See docs/api-contract.md, section CORS. Exactly four keys. Auth stores no name or avatar: keep profile data in your app, keyed by `id`.

401.description: One identical answer for no token, an expired or bad token, an unknown or inactive audience, an unknown account, or an origin not bound to the audience app. Never an allow header.

post.summary: Log in with email and password
post.description:
One identical 401 for every failure: unknown email, wrong password, unconfirmed or locked account, blocked pair, IP over its limit, unknown client, origin not bound. Never 429.

A request with an Origin header is allowed only when the origin is bound to the app the request identifies; the allow header is granted fail-closed. See docs/api-contract.md, section CORS.

200.description: A new access token and refresh token. No Set-Cookie.

post.description:
Consumes the presented refresh token and issues a new pair in the same session. A reused token revokes the session, except for one retry inside the grace window (REFRESH_REUSE_GRACE_SECONDS, default 10 s, same IP).

A request with an Origin header is allowed only when the origin is bound to the app the request identifies; the allow header is granted fail-closed. See docs/api-contract.md, section CORS.

post.summary: Revoke the session of a refresh token
post.description:
Idempotent and no oracle: 204 for an active, used, expired, unknown or other-app token. The session is revoked only when the token belongs to client_id and any Origin is bound to that app.

A request with an Origin header is allowed only when the origin is bound to the app the request identifies; the allow header is granted fail-closed. See docs/api-contract.md, section CORS.

Always the same 202. A confirmed account gets a reset email (1 h link); an unconfirmed account gets a confirmation email instead; an unknown address gets nothing.

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset token
post.description:
Replaces the password, uses the token and revokes every session of the account.

A request with an Origin header is allowed only when the origin is bound to the app the request identifies; the allow header is granted fail-closed. See docs/api-contract.md, section CORS.

204.description: No content. Password replaced, all sessions revoked.

400.description: Rejected request. A weak password keeps the token usable.

415.description: The Content-Type is not application/json, or is missing. No allow header, no limit counted.

429.description: An IP-keyed limit was hit. The decision never depends on account or token state.

post.summary: Change the password of the signed-in account
post.description:
Replaces the password, revokes every session including the caller's and queues a notice email. A wrong current password is 400, never 401. It counts as a failed login for both lockout counters.

A request with an Origin header is allowed only when the origin is bound to the app the request identifies; the allow header is granted fail-closed. See docs/api-contract.md, section CORS.

x-error-codes.where: Every POST under /api/v1: Content-Type is not application/json, or is missing.
Signup, resend, forgot, refresh: unknown or inactive client_id, or (signup, resend, forgot) origin not bound to it.
Signup, resend, forgot: the app has no email URLs.
Confirm, reset: bad token, or a known token from the wrong origin.
Change: wrong current password (also while blocked).
Login: one identical failure for every cause.
Refresh: the session or token is gone, or the origin is not bound.
/me, change: missing, expired or bad access token (header WWW-Authenticate: Bearer).
Signup, resend, forgot, reset, confirm, refresh (never login). Has Retry-After.
Endpoints that consult the limiter when its store is down.
